audit.summary: Archived assessment: Minor. Recorded check: Verification: The paper's own first-homotopy-sheaf formula on page 14 says pi_{n-1}(A^n minus 0)=K_n^MW. Substitute n=d+2.
limitations: Limits: No writing, build or acceptance decision delegated; primary independently checked the repaired cohomology logic and current report.
Limitations: This is a scientific initial review of the exact arXiv v2 PDF, not an audit of all previous literature and not a claim about a possibly different journal version.
Limitations: All 39 page texts were read, and 24 decisive page images were actually inspected. The other 15 rendered page images are not claimed as visually inspected.

Limitations: The proof depends on deep cited inputs: motivic representability and homotopy sheaf calculations; the Suslin matrix construction and its Chern classes; the Bertini and threefold divisibility theorems; norm residue and the Suslin/BVPW cohomological compatibility; Hermitian K-theory factorization and Grothendieck-Witt cohomology vanishing. Their complete external proofs were not independently re-proved here.

Limitations: The supplied completion of Lemma 4.0.8 covers the d!-invertible range of the main theorem. It does not independently establish the wider characteristic range advertised in Proposition 4.0.9 when char(k) divides d!.
Limitations: No counterexample to the main cancellation theorem was established. A local wrong index and an omitted cohomology comparison should not be recast as a disproved main theorem.
Limitations: No data/code supplement was available or required for the internal proof audit; its absence is not treated as a mathematical defect.

Limitations: The parent executor retains responsibility for the English final review report, its actual TeX compilation, final report PDF page inspection, synchronized delivery artifacts, and final severity calibration.
Limitations: The added kernel comparison assumes d! invertible and positive-dimensional connected components; wider characteristic-dividing-factorial auxiliary claims not completed.
Limitations: No counterexample to cancellation established; external foundational inputs not fully reproved.
Limitations: The completion is restricted to d! invertible and does not certify the wider characteristic-dividing-factorial auxiliary statements.

Limitations: Motivic representability/Postnikov theory, Morel and Suslin inputs, norm residue and contraction/Rost-Schmid machinery, Hermitian K factorization and GW vanishing remain cited external foundations.
Limitations: Exact arXiv v2 is retained, without journal equivalence or author-adoption claims. No author code or historical reviewer scripts were executed.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
